shortDescription: Manage resource group deployments on Dell PowerFlex.

options.name: clone_node
options.description: Resource to duplicate during scaleup, if more than one nodes are available in the resource group.

options.name: description
options.description: The description of the resource group.

options.name: firmware_repository_id
options.description: The ID of the firmware repository if not using the appliance default catalog. Mutually exclusive with I(firmware_repository_name).

options.name: firmware_repository_name
options.description: The name of the firmware repository if not using the appliance default catalog. Mutually exclusive with I(firmware_repository_id).

options.name: hostname
options.description: IP or FQDN of the PowerFlex host.

options.name: new_resource_group_name
options.description: New name of the resource group to rename to.

options.name: node_count
options.description: Number of nodes to clone during scaleup.

options.name: password
options.description: The password of the PowerFlex host.

options.name: port
options.description: Port number through which communication happens with PowerFlex host.

options.name: resource_group_id
options.description: The ID of the resource group. Either I(resource_group_id) or I(resource_group_name) must be specified to perform resource group operations. Mutually exclusive with I(resource_group_name).

options.name: resource_group_name
options.description: The name of the resource group. This is a required field to deploy a resource group. Either I(resource_group_id) or I(resource_group_name) must be specified to perform resource group operations. Mutually exclusive with I(resource_group_id).

options.name: scaleup
options.description: Whether to scale up the resource group. Specify as true to add nodes to the resource group.

options.name: schedule_date
options.description: Scheduled date for the resource group deployment. Specify in YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.sss or YYYY-MM-DD format.

options.name: state
options.description: The state of the resource group.

options.name: template_id
options.description: The ID of the published template. Either I(template_id) or I(template_name) must be specified to deploy a resource group. Mutually exclusive with I(template_name).

options.name: template_name
options.description: The name of the published template. Either I(template_id) or I(template_name) must be specified to deploy a resource group. Mutually exclusive with I(template_id).

options.name: timeout
options.description: Time after which connection will get terminated. It is to be mentioned in seconds.

options.name: username
options.description: The username of the PowerFlex host.

options.name: validate
options.description: Specify as true to validate the deployment of resource group.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Boolean variable to specify whether or not to validate SSL certificate. C(true) - Indicates that the SSL certificate should be verified. C(false) - Indicates that the SSL certificate should not be verified.
